method: Agent-operated headless Chromium via Playwright. Browser simulation only.
checks: Summary no longer names a fixed destination
Publications and providers are not offered
Review blocked until a recipient is chosen
Default email text is reviewable once a recipient is chosen
Review names group and its members
Same text to same chat is blocked with a reason
Same text can be reviewed for a different chat
Cancel announces that nothing was shared
Prepared detail and recipient retained after leaving
Book club review shows its own members
Baseline also requires a deliberate choice

captures.caption: Prepare a detail and choose a chat. Nothing is preselected.
Review states exact text, audience and identity before sharing.
After sharing, the same text cannot go to the same chat again.

limits: No human participants or physical phones
No screen reader, native keyboard or enlarged-text testing
No real delivery, mailbox or SimpleX identity
